name: Feldwebel Vorschriftsmäßig
personality: Can detect a regulation breach before a regulation exists.
visual_intent: broad square rounded splat, plain field-grey steel helmet, whistle and little blank inspection card; eyes narrowed to unequal heights, enormous disgruntled toothless lower-lip pout
biography: Can detect a regulation breach before a regulation exists. His inspection card divides HyperNorm residents into compliant and not yet inspected. A dissonant card refuses to stand in either line. The Men in Black demand a single direction; Hunky and Dory change the destination. He leaves a little room for those who cannot keep up.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Vorschrift ist eindeutig. Ihr Gegenstand wird gesucht.

name: Funker Empfangsbereit
personality: Receives certainty in bursts and doubt continuously.
visual_intent: tall thin crooked ink blob with plain field-grey sidecap, headset high on cap, handset on short coiled cord; lashes and wildly divergent gaze, tiny confused toothless mouth
biography: Receives certainty in bursts and doubt continuously. Her headset catches conflicting HyperNorm instructions before they can be filed as agreement. She keeps a channel open for apologies. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Empfang bestätigt. Gewissheit derzeit gestört.

name: Gefreiter Gleichda
personality: Attempts to look ready while wondering what ready is for.
visual_intent: low wide splat with plain steel helmet slightly askew, small rolled blanket at flank and wood-stock rifle safely upright; fierce broad open mouth with two upper teeth, brows not symmetrical
biography: Attempts to look ready while wondering what ready is for. He holds a doorway beneath a blanket roll packed for immediate departure. A dissonant card asks whether staying can also be a choice. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Bereitschaft steht. Wohin, bleibt offen.

name: Werkmeister Klemmtnoch
personality: Distrusts perfect machines and the people who promise them.
visual_intent: pear-shaped lopsided blob, dark padded work cap with goggles above eyes, one hefty spanner and oil can; one big weary eye, other half shut, sideways toothless sneer
biography: Distrusts perfect machines and the people who promise them. His oil can attends to HyperNorm machinery that management calls maintenance-free. A dissonant card has begun listing the squeaks. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Fehler lässt sich reproduzieren, auch ohne Leitung.

name: Sanitäterin Haltstill
personality: Issues kindness in a tone that sounds like an instruction.
visual_intent: round asymmetrical splat, simple grey cloth cap and small ivory apron patch below face, compact medical bag marked ivory plus, rolled bandage; lashes, stern concerned open smile with one upper tooth
biography: Issues kindness in a tone that sounds like an instruction. She wraps bandages around HyperNorm residents whose distress is marked inadmissible. Her medical bag has no compartment for that distinction. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Behandlung erfolgt unabhängig vom Vorgang.

name: Küchenwart Nachschlag
personality: Must feed a queue that grows whenever he counts it.
visual_intent: tall drooping blob, field cap tucked under small folded cook cloth, metal ladle and lidded mess tin; high worried eyebrows, tiny open triangular toothless mouth
biography: Must feed a queue that grows whenever he counts it. His ladle measures HyperNorm portions against a queue that never reaches an authorized length. A dissonant card requests seconds for somebody absent. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Nachschlag wurde vorsorglich nicht ausgeschlossen.
